note: GPU-side calibration inputs behind data/inputs/beta_operating_point.json and ripple_phases.json. They come from the analysis repository (decode-step and power model fitted to H100 measurements) at commit cc8fdf6, file pipeline/e2e_joint/<file>; this repository does not recompute them. 'commit' is the last commit that changed the file. The H100 slopes are listed as a cross-check: steps/measured.py recomputes them from data/measured.

inputs.name: a_G
inputs.what: HBM rise per non-memory W, 89 settled H100 rows

inputs.name: idle_W
inputs.what: [GPU, memory] idle power of the decode model
inputs.used_for: beta_operating_point.json; ripple_phases.json on phase and off-phase memory heat

inputs.name: mu_K
inputs.what: measured memory energy per KV byte read in H100 decoding
inputs.used_for: in-bank energy = s x mu_K (operating point, ripple_phases.json)

inputs.name: s
inputs.what: in-bank share of the read energy (HBM-PIM Sec. VII-C)

inputs.name: MAC
inputs.what: MAC energy per byte (AttAcc table value, charged on K and V)

inputs.name: E_BA
inputs.what: AttAcc table PIM energy per byte

inputs.name: rail_heat
inputs.what: share of memory-rail dynamic power that heats the HBM, fitted on 5 H100 decode runs

inputs.name: bw_timing
inputs.what: PIM bandwidth at tCCD_L from the AttAcc simulator (dram/ of this repository)

inputs.name: busy_factor
inputs.what: share of time not blocked by refresh

inputs.name: tdp
inputs.used_for: operating point (timing mode: no power constraint)

inputs.name: idle_premium
inputs.what: power above bare idle while a decode process is resident

inputs.name: fc_calib
inputs.what: FC-layer clock and power fit, 52 measured rows
inputs.used_for: GPU step time and power of the decode model

inputs.name: ripple_phases
inputs.what: decode-step phases of the ripple study

inputs.name: e_x_H100
inputs.what: in-bank energy of the operating point (the H100 threshold computed with beta 1.11)
